purpose: Paired before/after description routing regression queries; expectations are test inputs, not observed activation results.
description_before: Resolve consequential evidence gaps during Loom intent, spec or planning, and contradictions or repeated failures during build. Use when capability, version, compatibility or feasibility assumptions could change an engineering decision.
description_after: Resolve evidence gaps in Loom tasks or standalone engineering discussions when an unresolved premise could change a decision, including a small capability or version check. Routine lookups without a consequential gap remain ordinary work.
